gloss: the whole story; full account from beginning to end

definitions.gloss: the whole story; full account; every detail from start to finish
definitions.explanation: Refers to the complete sequence of events or facts, from the very beginning to the very end, without omitting anything.

examples.japanese: {事件|じけん}の{一部始終|いちぶしじゅう}を{話|はな}した。
examples.english: I told the whole story of the incident.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}はその{場|ば}の{一部始終|いちぶしじゅう}を{目撃|もくげき}していた。
examples.english: She had witnessed everything that happened at the scene.

examples.japanese: {防犯|ぼうはん}カメラに{事故|じこ}の{一部始終|いちぶしじゅう}が{記録|きろく}されていたおかげで、{原因|げんいん}が{特定|とくてい}できた。
examples.english: Because the security camera had recorded the entire accident from start to finish, the cause could be identified.

notes:
USAGE:
{一部始終|いちぶしじゅう} is a four-character compound (yojijukugo). Despite containing {一部|いちぶ} (one part), the expression means the complete story, not just a part. The {始終|しじゅう} means "from beginning to end."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一部始終|いちぶしじゅう}を{話|はな}す (to tell the whole story)
- {一部始終|いちぶしじゅう}を{見|み}る (to see everything)
- {一部始終|いちぶしじゅう}を{記録|きろく}する (to record the full account)
- {事件|じけん}の{一部始終|いちぶしじゅう} (the complete account of an incident)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {一部始終|いちぶしじゅう}: the whole story, full account (formal, emphasizes completeness)
- {顛末|てんまつ}: the full story, circumstances (formal, written)
- {経緯|けいい}: the details, how things developed (focuses on process)
